title: StillCut::Cutting and EditorStage::Encoding name a running worker whose task is .detach()ed, not held in the stage
trigger: Open the video editor, drag the cover (cut starts) or press Done (encode starts), then the scoped app handle stops answering (screen replaced) before the worker returns
effect: The stage stays Cutting/Encoding for the dialog's life: later cover cuts only queue `next` and never run, or the editor stays busy with Done greyed; answers are matched by a token/serial, not by owning the task
fix: StillCut::Cutting { token, next, _task: Task<()> } and EditorStage::Encoding { serial, _job: Task<()> } so leaving the stage cancels the worker (Reading already holds its probe)

title: State::sweep_due is a hand-cleared stage flag for the deferred sweep, next to the timer task
trigger: begin_render sets sweep_due and defers a closure that clears it by hand with `videos.with(..)`; if that borrow ever fails the clear is lost
effect: No later pass schedules a sweep (`defer = !replace(sweep_due, true)` stays false), so userpic players stop being paused and put to sleep until the app restarts; nothing today borrows the state across that deferred closure
fix: enum Sweep { Idle, Deferred, Armed { _timer: Task<()> } } replaced whole by the sweep itself, so a failed borrow cannot leave the flag set

title: A getUserFullInfo error is kept as asked for good, so that user's video userpic is never asked again
trigger: A Premium user's row draws while TDLib answers getUserFullInfo with an error (flood wait, offline blip): `userpic_full_info_asked` keeps (user, photo) and `release_userpic_full_info_ask` runs only on a failed send
effect: The chat list and history keep that user's still userpic for the session unless their profile is opened; the set also grows by one entry per user and photo
fix: Fetch<()> per (user, photo) held in the users state: an error answer is Failed with a retry after a delay, and the set is bounded by the owner
